[1/6] Plan: captain's log and discovery codex with persistent claimed milestones, derived statistics, achievement rewards, and CLI/REST/cockpit parity

impact_assessment.why: User chose a persistent discovery journal, codex entries, statistics and achievement rewards as the next Voidfarer feature.
impact_assessment.benefits: Gives long-term goals across exploration, command, commerce, combat and story; rewards existing play; surfaces progress the game already tracks but never displays.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: GameState save schema and existing G-001..G-012 layout rules must hold; dependency: stdlib and vanilla JS only; concurrency: engine lock and server ticker preserved; state: legacy saves need a defaulted CodexState and claimed milestones must persist atomically.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a defaulted frozen CodexState, derive progress from existing GameState/stats, persist only claimed ids and dates, add failing-first tests, and append CSS without altering base layout rules.

[1/6] Plan: Economy arbitrage guard, faction quotes, storage overflow checks, quantum fuel efficiency, cockpit shipyard/weapons parity, and combat fixes

impact_assessment.why: User requested bugfixes, closing feature gaps, economic sense, cargo/depot storage logic, and mechanical improvements.
impact_assessment.benefits: Prevents same-station infinite money exploits, makes faction standing affect visible quotes, stops cargo hold overflow on ship downgrades or refits, honors quantum fuel booster upgrades, fixes science skill fuel scooping, adds cockpit shipyard and weapons parity, and provides bulk depot actions.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Save schema and G-001..G-012 cockpit rules must hold; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: engine lock must guard all mutations; state: legacy saves must load cleanly without schema errors.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Preserve existing save structure with backward-compatible defaults, validate hold capacity before purchases/refits, keep base layout untouched while adding shipyard/weapons cards into existing ARSENAL drawer, and write failing-first tests for every fix.

[1/3] Audit the in-flight cockpit redesign, fix the JS parse breaks, and wire the PLAYER, SKILLS, CREW and SHIP tabs to the real simulation state

impact_assessment.why: The uncommitted cockpit redesign was syntactically invalid and its ship, crew, and creation flows called state fields and endpoints that do not exist
impact_assessment.benefits: A functional tabbed cockpit, truthful ship refits, persistent commander creation, and no dead or invented UI data
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new /api/ship/module and optional new-game profile; dependency: none added; concurrency: existing engine lock retained; state: commander name/age/background/skills persist with no schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Wrap the existing install/remove engine methods, validate profile values, remove unsupported perk/gender/race fields, and cover the new routes with server tests
